name: iPhone shared article summary through Nexus HTTP
target: A verified member submits an article scrap, requests a new model summary, and receives a durable generated result through the production Nexus HTTP route.
inputs: Isolated member ledger and verified app Bearer session
Fake LLM response injected at the Nexus HTTP server option
One extracted article body and an idempotency key
observations: POST and GET return the fake generated text with summarySource generated
The durable member event marks generated provenance and excludes another member
A failed model response falls back to stored-card provenance without leaking provider details
